about: The desktop client's look, read by `wfg serve --window --theme=<this file>` at start and again on F5. The tokens are the ones clients/console/styles.css declares. Most carry the page's values; three greys are lighter here and the inspector's ground is blue rather than violet, because a browser and JUCE do not lay type down the same way and the author read both surfaces (2026-09-18). What the two share is the intention, not the hex. Colours are #rrggbb; `type` scales every font; `refreshHz` is how often the window reads the engine; `row` is a row's height in pixels before `type` scales it. A token left out keeps its default; one misspelled is refused by name; a file that does not parse changes nothing, and the window says why on its status line.
